column1: Put the dates and baking soda in a heatproof bowl, cover with the boiling water, press the dates under, and soak 10 minutes.
Beat the butter and brown sugar on high about 1 minute until fluffy, then mix in the egg on medium.
On low speed, add the flour and baking powder and mix until just combined.
Blend the soaked dates and their liquid to a puree and mix it into the batter on low.
Grease and flour 6 muffin cups and divide the batter among them.
Bake 17–19 minutes until a toothpick comes out mostly clean, then cool 5 minutes and turn out.
Meanwhile, bring all sauce ingredients except the bourbon to a boil in a small saucepan, stirring to dissolve the sugar, and boil 3 minutes until thickened.
Take the sauce off the heat, stir in the bourbon, and let it cool slightly.
Spoon the sauce over the warm puddings and serve right away with whipped cream.
